job.description: N13's full-length calibration run, before any real N13 run: seed 3001 only. Trains n80-rw, n80-mix-rep and n80-w02 at full length, re-measures N12's calibration models (n80, n80-mix, sub20 of seed 3001, read from the n12_calib Drive folder) on the held-out tail's windows 513-1024, and compares each new model with its N12 partner. It decides nothing: it measures the replicate floor that N13a's tolerance depends on. NEEDS AN A100: before Run all, choose Runtime > Change runtime type > A100 GPU. On any other GPU it stops before training. About 15 minutes. Resumable: if a session ends, choose Run all again and finished work is skipped.
